 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHOK KUMAR PANDEY  CAV ORDER 6 09-04-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner; learned counsel for the BSFC and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 409 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The case of the prosecution is that the District Manager S.F.C. Darbhanga lodged a written report stating therein that vide letter No. 663 dated 27.04.2022 of District Magistrate, Darbhanga in presence of T.D.P.S., Benipur an inventory was prepared by breaking the lock of Godown No. 1, in which, they found altogether 3710.98400 quintal rice and 3298.3600 quintal wheat and on next day, in Godown No. 2, 991.00 quintal wheat Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.73136 of 2024(6)
dt.09-04-2025 was found and from this, it is clear that altogether 47 lacks an odd amount has been embezzled and the informant requested to lodge FIR against the petitioner.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He has falsely been implicated in this case.
He also submits that the petitioner joined as Assistant Manager T.D.P.S. Benipur on 12.09.2016.
He was also given extra charge of Kusheshwar Asthan godown on 04.01.2019 and on 04.03.2023 of Biroul and Biroul Sahri Godown.
Petitioner has got difficulty due to different work load.

Petitioner has written many letters to the appropriate authority to appoint full-fledged officers to hold charge of these charges and relieve him to do his own duty properly but his grievance was not considered.
A table has been annexed in the application to show that there was no embezzlement.

Moreover, the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 02.08.2024.
5.
As against this, the learned counsel for the B.S.F.C. has opposed the prayer for bail.
It has been argued that the anticipatory bail of the petitioner was rejected by this Hon'ble Court.

From perusal of the Annexure P/3 series, it transpires that prior to the occurrence, the petitioner has written letter to Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.73136 of 2024(6) dt.09-04-2025 appropriate authority stating therein that he was overburdened and he is not able to work at different places.

It is also pertinent to note here that in this case, D.M., S.F.C. has also filed counter affidavit but they have not denied the table of para-19 of this petition and on the force of this, the learned counsel has submitted that the petitioner deserves bail.
It has also been submitted that the disciplinary proceeding has also been initiated against him.
Learned APP for the State has also opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that petitioner is having criminal antecedent of one case.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with Bahera P.S. Case No. 218 of 2022 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned 1 st Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Benipur, Darbhanga.
(Ashok Kumar Pandey, J) Shubham/-
Sudhanshu/-
